items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewee discusses a duet with 'Ray Nance' and mentions 'Elvin “Ray” Jones' only in the interviewer's question regarding a middle name usage, with no personal interaction or relationship described between the interviewee and Elvin Ray Jones.

ctx.x: You noticed he used a middle name on that?
Elvin “Ray” Jones, yes. Why was that?
I think it had to do with color maybe.
